sufficiency.reason: The best hypothesis agrees on 82 of 116 parity checks (70.7%), but it is the best of 32076 tried: after correcting for the search its evidence is 10^-0.8, which is what chance alone produces.
sufficiency.what_would_prove_it: Nothing about this hypothesis is trending. A longer capture of the same signal is not expected to change it; a better signal-to-noise ratio, a different receiver, or a structure outside the current catalogue would be needed.
